name: Planning Basement Wall Framing: Checklist for Permit and Inspection Readiness

step.name: Step 1: [ ] Inspect concrete foundation walls for moisture or leaks — Water…
step.text: [ ] Inspect concrete foundation walls for moisture or leaks — Water intrusion must be resolved completely before wood or insulation touches the space.

step.name: Step 2: [ ] Measure finished ceiling clearance to verify a 7-foot height al…
step.text: [ ] Measure finished ceiling clearance to verify a 7-foot height allowance — Habitable rooms usually require a minimum finished ceiling height of seven feet under standard residential codes.

step.name: Step 3: [ ] Identify all structural support posts and load-bearing partitio…
step.text: [ ] Identify all structural support posts and load-bearing partitions — Non-bearing room dividers use standard stud spacing, but support posts require dedicated engineering and framing considerations.

step.name: Step 4: [ ] Source pressure-treated lumber for all slab-contact bottom plat…
step.text: [ ] Source pressure-treated lumber for all slab-contact bottom plates — Building codes require treated wood or approved barriers wherever framing rests directly on concrete floors.

step.name: Step 5: [ ] Map out locations for cleanouts, shutoff valves, and electrical…
step.text: [ ] Map out locations for cleanouts, shutoff valves, and electrical panels — Wall frames must never enclose or obstruct necessary utility shutoffs without leaving accessible openings.

step.name: Step 6: [ ] Secure building permits from your local jurisdiction — Most mun…
step.text: [ ] Secure building permits from your local jurisdiction — Most municipalities mandate approved building permits prior to constructing new walls or adding living space.

step.name: Step 7: [ ] Mark fireblocking positions at 10-foot intervals and wall-ceili…
step.text: [ ] Mark fireblocking positions at 10-foot intervals and wall-ceiling junctions — Fire stops are required in concealed spaces to prevent the rapid spread of flames and draft between cavities.

step.name: Step 8: [ ] Verify required egress window dimensions if framing a bedroom —…
step.text: [ ] Verify required egress window dimensions if framing a bedroom — Sleeping areas have strict opening size and well-clearance standards that framing must not infringe upon.
